item.title: Vietnam Airlines (HVN) profit hit hard by rising fuel costs
item.description: Profit after tax attributable to shareholders of the parent company is projected at only around VNĐ1.1 trillion, down 85 per cent from 2025.

item.title: Searefico Rolls Out Nearly 9.6 Hectares of Industrial and Logistics Projects
item.description: In the final week of August, Searefico broke ground on four projects in Tay Ninh and Da Nang, expanding its operations from engineering and construction into industrial and logistics asset development and operations.

item.title: Coteccons (CTD) reports excellent 2026 results, profits surge 72.7%
item.description: Coteccons Construction JSC (HOSE: CTD) has reported strong results for fiscal year 2026 (from July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026), with both revenues and profits recording robust growth and exceeding targets.

item.title: HDB reports 31 per cent profit growth, joins Việt Nam’s trillion-VNĐ asset club, and secures landmark international deals
item.description: The Ho Chi Minh City Development Joint Stock Commercial Bank reported strong first-half 2026 results, surpassing VNĐ1 quadrillion (US$38.1 billion) in assets, posting more than VNĐ13.2 trillion (US$502.8 million) in pre-tax profit, and strengthening its position in international capital markets.

item.title: Hòa Phát posts (HPG) VNĐ15.5 trillion profit in H1, achieves 70% of annual target
item.description: The company has set 2026 targets of VNĐ210 trillion in revenue and VNĐ22 trillion in after-tax profit.

item.title: Dabaco (DBC) reports a drop in net profit after tax in the first half of 2026
item.description: Dabaco Vietnam Group reported net-profit after tax of VND289.12 billion ($7.5 million) in the second quarter of 2026, down 43 per cent on-year, as falling live pig prices eroded margins despite revenue growing 11.1 per cent to $170 million over the same period.

item.title: Tien Phong Plastic (NTP) posts record quarterly profit as earnings jump over 50%
item.description: According to the company, business operations were adjusted flexibly in response to market developments, helping expand market share, attract new customers.

item.title: Bình Minh Plastics posts record second quarter profit
item.description: Bình Minh Plastics posted a record profit in the second quarter of 2026, with net profit rising 11.3 per cent from a year earlier to VNĐ367 billion (US$14 million), according to the company's financial statement.

item.title: Hoa Sen Group (HSG) exceeds full-year profit target after nine months
item.description: Consolidated after-tax profit is estimated at VNĐ568 billion, or 114 per cent of the annual profit target approved by shareholders under the company's first business scenario.

item.title: Same-store sales drive Dien May Xanh's (DMX) first-half revenue
item.description: Dien May Xanh Investment JSC (DMX) reported first-half consolidated revenue of $2.61 billion, up 31 per cent on-year, driven by strong air conditioning seasonal demand and broad-based same-store sales growth across its retail network.
